name: iVest donation-on-burn double debit
summary: Transfers to the zero address trigger the token's _MakeDonation path, which debits the sender's balance a second time; repeatedly sending iVest to the PancakeSwap pair and calling skim/sync shrank the pair's token reserve and let the attacker swap the reserve out for WBNB.
